purpose: A learner locates returned discussion topics by literal text in the title or complete normalized opening prompt across deliberately selected course occurrences, then uses the existing discussion reader.

baseline.normalization: CanvasAPI.list_discussion_topics(course_id) unchanged. Existing get_paginated GET /api/v1/courses/{course_id}/discussion_topics with order_by=recent_activity and only_announcements=False. Projection id/title/posted_at/published/message_text/html_url; strip_html removes tags before HTML entity unescaping and collapses whitespace; non-dict raw rows are skipped by this existing reader.

additive_only: src/canvaspilot/cli.py: one find-discussions parser and one early dispatch span

interfaces.cli: canvaspilot find-discussions COURSE_ID... --text QUERY [--base-url URL] [--profile PATH] [--token TOKEN]
interfaces.search: search_discussions(selections, query) -> dict; selections is a list of exact-key {course_id, topics} objects, topics are complete normalized reader rows.
interfaces.collect: collect_discussions(api, course_ids, query) -> dict; validate before calling api.list_discussion_topics, call once for each selected occurrence in explicit order, then return one whole result.
interfaces.serialize: serialize_discussion_search(result) -> str; complete pretty JSON plus one LF, with a 16 MiB UTF-8 bound.
interfaces.runner: run_find_discussions(args) -> None; uses the existing CanvasAPI/CanvasClient and common CLI arguments, closes owned client and restores HTTPX logger level before complete success output.

admission.courses: A list or tuple of 1..10 selected occurrences. Each course is an exact int (not bool) or a nonempty string of at most 20 ASCII decimal digits; positive and no more than 20 decimal digits. Normalize leading zeroes to the positive decimal string. Repeated normalized course IDs are deliberately preserved as separate selection_number occurrences and read once per occurrence; no deduplication.
admission.query: Exact str containing at least one non-whitespace character, at most 512 UTF-8 bytes. Preserve all meaningful whitespace exactly. Unencodable Unicode is refused.
admission.selections: Exact list with 1..10 exact dict selections, each containing only course_id and topics. course_id admitted identically; topics exact list. At most 1000 normalized topic rows across all occurrences, no truncation. Empty topics allowed.
admission.rows: Every normalized topic row is an exact dict and must include all six projected keys id, title, posted_at, published, message_text, html_url. title must be str or None; message_text must be str. Other projected and additional supplied metadata retain their JSON values without coercion. Reject non-JSON, non-string object keys, tuples/custom containers, nonfinite floats, unencodable strings, cycles or excessive recursive structure instead of silently converting. Limit nesting to 32 containers including the selections root.
admission.total_bytes: At most 8 MiB for JSON of the complete normalized selections with ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False and separators=(',',':'), encoded as UTF-8. Limit is after the existing reader has already decoded/normalized; it is not a network-byte or raw Canvas response bound.
admission.refusal: Validate all selected normalized data, including nonmatching later rows/courses, before returning a report. Invalid record/limit/serialization or any reader exception gives no partial successful report. Inputs are never mutated.

matching.rule: query.casefold() substring independently in each title (if str) and complete message_text.casefold(); no regex, tokenization, accent folding, Unicode normalization, joining fields, sorting, ranking, snippets or slicing.
matching.ordering: Selections in explicit user order, topic positions in each unchanged reader result. A topic appears once per original position when either field matches; matched_fields lists title then message_text. Equal IDs/titles/content remain distinct original occurrences.
matching.identity: selection_number and topic_position are one-based. course_id is the normalized explicit selection, not inferred from title or embedded URL. The complete admitted normalized topic row is detached from input and preserved.
matching.no_match: A valid report with matches=[], matched_count=0; does not prove inaccessible, omitted raw, attachment or reply content lacks the phrase.
matching.empty_prompt: Count empty normalized message_text strings as empty_message_text_count; raw missing/null/media-only distinctions are unavailable after existing normalization and are not invented.

output.boundary: Searches only returned titles and complete normalized opening prompts from the existing topic-list reader; not replies, attachments, hidden/unavailable raw content or a freshness/completeness guarantee. The existing paginator is reused unchanged; pagination failure refuses the result, and its provider conventions/limits remain.
output.preserved_values: Unknown metadata, None/False/0/empty distinctions survive in matched topic rows. Result objects share no mutable input object. No raw HTML recovery or alternative cleanup.

cli_behavior.invalid_input: Invalid course/query/selection before client/profile construction: structured JSON stderr, exit 2, empty stdout. argparse --help/unknown/missing argument behavior stays normal and occurs before client construction.
cli_behavior.read_or_output_failure: CanvasAuthError, CanvasPaginationError, HTTPX HTTPError, invalid normalized data/serialization, ordinary I/O or Unicode/value delivery failure: structured stderr when possible, exit 1, no partial successful JSON; a failed/partial output delivery is not called success. No retry.
cli_behavior.stdout: On success output exactly one serialized result and flush; check short text writes. No logging on success stdout. HTTPX logger suppression is temporary and original level restored. Completion relies on actual runner return/CLI exit, not merely prepared JSON.
cli_behavior.effects: Only the unchanged selected course topic-list calls. No detail/view/thread fetch, POST, mark-read, reply, subscription, attachment/URL follow, cache/storage/file export, live token/account mutation or source change.

qualification.author: Focused standard-library in-memory helper and actual CLI-source dispatch tests with exact source-bound fake API/client transport; original absent-command witness retained. Existing real CanvasAPI normalization is exercised in memory with a finite fake transport.
qualification.independent: Root freezes concrete expectations before candidate exposure; independent receiving remains separate from author tests.
qualification.limits: Source/fixture receiving is not installed package, live Canvas, token/session pagination, physical terminal/browser/account acceptance. No dependencies installed, file writes, native machine probes or Actions.
